verdict.rationale: Rive documents public programmatic interfaces in its open-source runtime SDKs, which load and control animations and state machines and expose data-binding parameters such as bindViewModelInstance. It also documents an MCP connection to the Editor. However, probes show there is no HTTP or REST API for the platform or editor: no OpenAPI spec exists, and the served spec is a Mintlify sample. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP/REST API for the editor/platform, a machine-readable API specification, and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.
Data binding — autoBind, view models, bindViewModelInstance
Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.
You can connect the Rive Editor to AI tools through MCP (Model Context Protocol).
